name: KnowledgeOwl
description: Articles, versions, categories, files, agents, readers, access controls, comments, snippets, tags, synonyms, webhooks, and remote-login resources through KnowledgeOwl's External API.
agentUseSummary: Enter a customer-owned knowledge base ID and API key once, then let agents use the complete key-authorized External API under Safe or Dangerously skip permissions.

credentialRequirements.name: KNOWLEDGEOWL_PROJECT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: KnowledgeOwl knowledge base ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Copy the project ID shown after /articles/id/ in the KnowledgeOwl admin URL.

credentialRequirements.name: KNOWLEDGEOWL_API_KEY
credentialRequirements.label: KnowledgeOwl API key
credentialRequirements.helpText: A Full Admin creates a dedicated key under Account > API and limits its allowed HTTP methods.

capabilities.label: Read knowledge
capabilities.description: List and read bounded articles and categories in the configured knowledge base.

capabilities.label: Maintain knowledge
capabilities.description: Create, update, version, upload, organize, and delete content permitted by the key.

capabilities.label: Manage people and access
capabilities.description: Manage agents, readers, roles, teams, and reader filters permitted by the key.

capabilities.label: Manage knowledge-base resources
capabilities.description: Manage filters, snippets, synonyms, tags, webhooks, files, comments, and remote-login resources.

allowed.label: List articles
allowed.description: List one bounded page of articles in the connected knowledge base.

allowed.label: Read article
allowed.description: Read one article from the connected knowledge base.

allowed.label: List categories
allowed.description: List one bounded page of categories in the connected knowledge base.

approvalRequired.label: Upload file
approvalRequired.description: Upload one bounded file to the connected knowledge base; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalRequired.label: Use full External API
approvalRequired.description: Use any current documented External API operation; Safe mode requires approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Bounded article and category reads run directly; uploads and every other External API operation require approval.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: Every selected API-key-authorized operation runs without Relay per-action approval; ownership, fixed origin, project binding, bounds, audits, redaction, key method permissions, and provider limits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts typed wrappers and injects the encrypted customer key server-side.
Railway mounts typed wrappers and injects the encrypted customer key server-side.

providerSetup.blocker: No customer KnowledgeOwl account, project ID, API key, or signed-in provider session was available.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer Full Admin creates a dedicated method-limited API key, enters the knowledge base ID and key, then Relay runs health, bounded reads, Safe denial plus approval, Dangerous mutation, key revocation, and disconnect checks.

evidence.supports: The API is plan-gated, HTTPS-only, uses a Full-Admin-created customer API key as the Basic username with a dummy password, supports method restrictions, and recommends fewer than 1,500 requests per five minutes.

The official endpoint reference links the current OpenAPI specification covering articles, versions, categories, files, agents, readers, access controls, comments, snippets, tags, synonyms, webhooks, and remote-login resources.
The official cookbook documents multipart file creation and replacement with project_id, status, name, and file fields.
